prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Flerovium (Fl) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a mint vault of stacked gold bars, trays of fresh coins and a heavy steel door, warm lamplight on the metal
Time of day: daytime indoors — bright, even light filling the room; daylight bouncing softly off pale walls.
Outfit: an angel-and-devil party costume cut as a stage leotard with sheer tights — a small horn headband, a halo and a tail prop — in deep amethyst purple; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 80-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 60-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; camera slightly below, looking up at her.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a small glass fishing float holding a pinch of white coral sand and a single gleaming silver bead at chest height; it is all she holds.
LEGS: mid-stride, one heel lifting.
GAZE: she looks toward the far distance.
EXPRESSION: brows level, eyes bright and steady, closed-lip smile with a firm mouth.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — flerovium: a synthetic superheavy element sitting at the edge of the island of stability, a theory from the 1960s that nuclei whose protons and neutrons fill certain magic numbers should live far longer than their neighbours; first caught in 1998 by firing calcium ions at a plutonium target, and named for the laboratory that made it; its atoms live for seconds, thousands of times longer than those around it, the first sign that the island is near, though no one has yet reached its centre; it sits below carbon, silicon, germanium, tin and lead, and a few atoms showed it to be the most volatile metal of that column — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text or numbers other than her element's own symbol and atomic number, no logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.
